manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed upward beside a velocity-time graph. At the top the velocity is zero but the slope stays -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: The left scene shows a vertical toss on a height ruler. The right graph plots velocity against time with a linked marker. The readouts show velocity, acceleration, gravitational force and motion state.
